original.target_description: Primary original paper could not be acquired within the acquisition allowance. DOI publisher returned a 403 challenge; OpenAlex had no best OA location; author site had a TLS hostname mismatch; CiteSeer alternative returned 404. Original statistics summarized in the replication article were not substituted for the primary paper.

replication.target_description: Study 5 kind-of-object main effect (colored dots versus shapes) requested. The final article names this factor in its 5 × 5 × 2 ANOVA but does not print a statistic, effect size, p value, or analytic n for this term in Study 5 Results (p. 9).

reported_success.quote: we again failed to replicate the effect of variety on perceived quantity.

notes: Full replication paper available and title verified. Supplied p. 22 differs from final publication. Target test not reported in located Results; other ANOVA terms were not substituted. Failure verdict is authors’ study-level verdict for variety, not a verdict for kind of object.
